run_search_service: run the huggingface dataset viewer search service as a starlette uvicorn server
create_search_endpoint: create a starlette endpoint that performs full-text BM25 search on duckdb indexed datasets
create_filter_endpoint: create a starlette endpoint that filters dataset rows using SQL where and orderby clauses
full_text_search: run a full-text BM25 search query against a duckdb index file and return results
execute_filter_query: execute a filter query with where and orderby clauses against a duckdb index file
